items.source: Write the given object to the response stream, without flushing. Strings will be sent as UTF-8 encoded bytes, byte arrays will be sent as-is, and other objects will be converted into JSON using message converters.
items.translation: 将给定对象写入响应流，但不刷新。字符串将以 UTF-8 编码的字节形式发送，字节数组将原样发送，而其他对象将通过消息转换器转换为 JSON。

items.source: IOException - in case of I/O errors
items.translation: `IOException` - 在发生 I/O 错误时

items.source: Flush the buffered response stream content to the network.
items.translation: 将缓冲的响应流内容刷新到网络。

items.source: Register a callback to be invoked when the request completes.
items.translation: 注册一个回调，在请求完成时调用它。

items.source:
Register a callback to be invoked when an error occurs during
processing.
items.translation: 注册一个回调，以便在加工过程中发生错误时调用。

items.source:
Register a callback to be invoked when a request times
out.
items.translation: 注册一个回调，在请求超时时调用。

items.source: Write the given object to the response stream, without flushing.
items.translation: 将给定对象写入响应流，但不刷新。

items.source: object - the object to send as data
mediaType - the media type to use for encoding the provided data
items.translation: mediaType - 用于编码所提供数据的媒体类型

items.source:
The throwable is dispatched back into Spring MVC, and passed to
its exception handling mechanism. Since the response has
been committed by this point, the response status can not change.
items.translation: 该异常被重新分发回 Spring MVC，并传递给其异常处理机制。由于此时响应已提交，响应状态码无法更改。

items.source: Defines a builder for a streaming response body.
items.translation: 定义用于流式响应体的构建器。

items.source: Completes the stream with the given error.
onTimeout - the callback to invoke on timeout
items.translation: onTimeout - 超时时调用的回调函数

items.source: onError - the callback to invoke on error
items.translation: onError - 出错时调用的回调函数

items.source: onCompletion - the callback to invoked on completion
